name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: CRM & Lifecycle Email Marketing | Segmentation, Personalization, Automation, A/B Testing
summary: Lifecycle and CRM marketer who builds and runs email programs end to end. At Solenzo I design, build, and optimize automated lifecycle journeys for consumer-facing service businesses: onboarding, nurture, booking reminders, no-show recovery, reactivation of lapsed customers, and review requests across 20+ production workflows, with segmentation, lifecycle stages, and lead scoring in GoHighLevel and HubSpot. At Level Agency I built complex email sequences and landing pages for accounts spending $20K+/month on ads, ran A/B tests, and reported ROI, CAC, and conversion KPIs.

experience.title: Lifecycle & CRM Marketing — Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Design and deploy automated lifecycle email journeys that activate, nurture, and retain customers, including onboarding, booking confirmations and reminders, no-show recovery, reactivation of lapsed customers, and review requests.
Build segmentation, lifecycle stages, lead scoring, and qualification criteria in GoHighLevel and HubSpot, with strict data-hygiene rules so personalization holds up.
Built segmented outreach campaigns tailored to each audience's specific problem, plus an automated audit workflow that enrolled 180+ contacts and triggered personalized follow-up.
Write email copy, subject lines, and landing pages; track performance with GA4, UTM conventions, and dashboards, and iterate based on results.
